verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical and share the same flaws. The photo is squeezed into a narrow centre strip that cuts off the praying hands. A white text panel cuts across the bottom of the photo with no clear intent. The cloud shapes float white-on-white in the empty left third, where they read as leftover debris. Half the canvas is dead white space. The only difference is a slight shift in where the small plus marks and dot sit, which doesn't change the result.
